name: Eremosuchus
sum: Eremosuchus is a ziphodont sebecosuchian notosuchian from the Early Eocene El Kohol Formation of Algeria.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A dentary and associated mandible and cranial fragments (UOK 347 is the specimen shown in Commons images) found in 1982 at El Kohol; much of the original collection has since been lost.
material: Isolated cranial and postcranial material described in 1989.
biology: Like other sebecids it had serrated, blade-like (ziphodont) teeth.
author: Buffetaut 1989
